purpose: The custom checkbox of the vendored Finsweet cookie-preference panel. Four instances: one always-on, three toggleable.

props.label: 1-2 words plus an explanatory line: Marketing, Personalization, Analytics, "Strictly necessary (always active)"
props.name: Fs-Marketing / Fs-Personalization / Fs-Analytics

states.checked: fill vendor.cookie-accent with radio__checkmark.svg as background-image
states.hover: text turns vendor.cookie-accent-soft, fill becomes surface.page
states.focus: box-shadow: none is declared explicitly on .fs-cc_checkbox-button.w--redirected-focus, i.e. Webflow's focus ring is deliberately removed.

responsive.base: stacked rows in the preference modal

notes: VENDORED Finsweet component. Its colours are namespaced vendor.cookie-* precisely so a generator cannot mistake #146ef5 for a Fourmula brand colour. The form it sits in carries a Cloudflare Turnstile sitekey attribute (data-turnstile-sitekey) that is inert in this clone.
